product_metadata.title: S&T INC. Dish Soap Dispenser and Sponge Holder for Kitchen Sink with Enhanced Features, Sponge Included, 13 Ounces, Matte White
features: One matte white dish soap dispenser for kitchen sink that provides compact storage for dish soap and dish sponge, eliminating sink clutter
Easily press down on the top plate on the dish detergent dispenser to dispense dish soap directly on to the included sponge
Enhanced, patent-pending design features an elevated top plate to promote drying of the sink sponge holder
Stable, non-slip feet help keep the sponge soap dispenser in place for secure grip on counters
Use with any dish scrubber, sponge, or dish cloth; holds 13 ounces of your favorite dish soap

details.Warranty Description: This product is guaranteed to provide satisfactory performance. Material items that possess defective workmanship that have been properly cared for as instructed on the package will be replaced free of charge within 60 days from purchase. This warranty does not cover damage due to improper use or general wear and tear. Please retain defective product for possible future inspection.
